Hello Beaches Dental Health Team,

We noticed that prospective patients reaching your practice in Toronto outside standard clinic hours frequently drop off.

GARUDA OS provides a 24/7 AI Clinical Intake Receptionist that:
• Engages patients instantly in <3 seconds (Web & WhatsApp)
• Pre-triages symptoms & answers procedure FAQs
• Books appointments directly into your clinic calendar

Interactive live architecture demo:
👉 https://www.garudaos.in/chat?ref=CA-DEN-022

Best regards,
Praveen Mahawar (GARUDA OS | praveen@garudaos.in)
